s: the Stockbridge bakery whose croissants built queues and a cult following fast
w: Opened on Hamilton Place and quickly acquired near-mythical status for its precise, laminated viennoiserie -- the croissants are regularly cited among the best in the UK. Small operation, big word-of-mouth following, and queues that form before opening. The kind of place serious pastry people plan a Stockbridge morning around.
_facts: Located at 29-35 Hamilton Place, Stockbridge, Edinburgh EH3 5BA
Known for precise, widely praised croissants and viennoiserie
Built a fast-growing following via word-of-mouth and social media
Also serves coffee alongside its bakery and pantry offering
